description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class for setting global CORS policies for a backend API. It specifies allowed origins, methods, headers, and other settings for cross-origin requests, primarily to facilitate communication with an Angular frontend and manage security considerations.

classes.name: WebCorsConfig
